posts.text:
Agriculture is the heart and soul of what we do in Nebraska.

Happy National Agriculture Day!

The Venerable Father Flanagan was a dedicated priest and exemplary Nebraskan.  His commitment to the Catholic faith and the welfare of children is a model for us all.  Father Flanagan’s work with Boys Town made sure that countless young Nebraskans had the education, support, and community they needed to succeed.  We still see the benefits of his mission today. Thank you, Pope Leo XIV, for recognizing Father Flanagan’s life and work.

Great to welcome Nebraska’s heroic national guardsmen to DC! With Spring Break season in full force, and Nebraskans visiting our nation’s capital, these heroes are helping keep the city safe. Thank you for your service!

Video

Markwayne Mullin is a patriot and a good man. He’s been a great colleague and friend in the Senate.

I know he will be a great Secretary at DHS. His job faces a tough path with Democrats unwilling to reconcile on a plan to reopen the Department of Homeland Security. But if anyone is up for the job, it’s @SenMullin. Congratulations Secretary Mullin!

Thank you to @TeamPillen for organizing today’s aerial tour of the wildfires. And thank you @secrollins from coming to Western Nebraska to see the damages impacting so many Nebraska farmers and ranchers.

Nebraska leaders and Sec. Rollins answered media questions after the aerial tour.

I am praying for those affected, and doing all I can to help in the recovery efforts.

Footage from today’s aerial tour of the wildfire damage in Western Nebraska.

Video
  



Video
  



Video

Here at the Ogallala Airport with @SecRollins for an aerial tour of the fire damage in Western Nebraska.

My heart and prayers continue to go out to those impacted. I will do all I can to support relief efforts.

Noise from the Chinook helicopter in the background. Watch and read captions!

Video

Great to meet with the Nebraska Native American school superintendents. I had the opportunity to hear about their important work serving Nebraska’s Native American communities. We also discussed how I can support their work to improve educational opportunities for Native Americans in Nebraskans.
Noah Tietjens is the definition of a heroic Nebraskan. His posthumous promotion to Master Sergeant is an honor fitting of his sacrifice. The Tietjens family remains in my prayers.

Democrats must negotiate in good faith to reopen the Department of Homeland Security.

Enough is enough.

Video

Congratulations to @loperwrestling on winning this year’s NCAA Division II Men’s Wresting National Championship!

You make the entire state of Nebraska proud. Go Lopers!

Today is the 34th day of the partial government shutdown. Despite the White House and @SenateGOP offering to work in good faith with @SenateDems, they refuse to fund DHS, pay TSA agents, and reopen the department. 

Democrats only agreed to negotiate for the first time yesterday. It’s time for the Democrats to do the right thing and end the shutdown.

Agriculture is the heart and soul of what we do in Nebraska. This National Ag Week, I’m celebrating all the farmers and ranchers that feed and fuel the world.

In the Senate, we passed the Working Families Tax Cuts to put more money in the pockets of farmers and ranchers.

I wrote the CARING for Our Veterans Act to ensure our veterans receive the best standard of care. It will enhance how community care providers share medical records with VA medical centers. 

I'm excited that it passed out of @SVACGOP unanimously yesterday!

GO BIG RED!

Our first March Madness victory in program history! Congrats Huskers!


Nebraska Men's Basketball (@HuskerMBB)

SOME DAY IS TODAY.

This year’s @HuskerMBB historic season continues today. Good luck to the Huskers as they face off against Troy today.
 
Tip off at 11:40 AM CT. #GBR
Big win last night for the @HuskerWBB team. Onto the next one. GO BIG RED!

Happy National Ag week! Agriculture is the heart and soul of Nebraska. When we invest in our young farmers and ranchers, we're securing the future of the safest and most abundant food supply in the world.

We supported this future in the Working Families Tax Cuts with an extension of the Beginning Farmer and Rancher Development Benefit and a permanent Death Tax exemption. This helps young farmers and ranchers start their own operation or take over the family business.
